CyberScraper 2077 is an AI-powered web scraping tool that leverages LLMs like OpenAI, Gemini, and Ollama to intelligently extract data from websites. It features a user-friendly Streamlit interface, supports multiple export formats, and includes advanced features like Tor network access, stealth mode, and captcha bypassing.
